notes.title: Get Ready to Test RC Car Simulator – Playtest Coming Soon!
notes.notes:
Great news, racers!

We’re preparing a playtest for RC Car Simulator, and we want YOU to join us! This is your chance to play early, experience the chaotic RC racing fun, and help shape the game with your feedback.
What is RC Car Simulator?

RC Car Simulator isn’t just a racing game - it’s a massive playground where you control realistic RC cars in a world built for creativity and mayhem. Whether you prefer stunt jumps, obstacle courses, open-world exploration, or competitive racing, there’s something for everyone. With detailed physics, a variety of RC vehicles, and exciting maps, the game delivers an authentic yet thrilling experience.
Why join the Playtest?

In this Playtest, you’ll get to test different cars, explore diverse environments, and push the limits of our physics engine. Your insights will help us fine-tune mechanics, improve gameplay, and add new features. We value your feedback, and this is your chance to influence the final version of the game!
How to join?

We’ll be sharing details soon on how to sign up for the Playtest. Keep an eye on our Steam page and community channels so you don’t miss out!

We can’t wait to hear your thoughts and improve RC Car Simulator together.
See you on the track!
